messages:
Priya: Thanks everyone for the all-hands. Quick question about the regional warmup timeline — are we prioritizing EMEA T4s for next week or APAC? Need to know for a customer whose Dedicated capacity depends on it.
Kaitlyn: Good q. Short answer: EMEA first, APAC the following week. We're balancing supplier lead times + committed customers. More details below.
Miguel: EMEA priority is because we have 3 enterprise commits in EMEA that start 2026-04-01. APAC has less committed demand but higher burst risk.
Sasha: To add — autoscaler changes for warmup will be merged today. It adds a 'prewarm' policy per region.
Jordan: Where's the policy config? can we see an example to update customer runbooks?
Sam: Pasting the dev preview config we used in canary:
```
autoscaler:
  regions:
    - name: europe-west1
      prewarm: true
      prewarm_min_gpus: 8
      prewarm_window: "02:00-06:00"
    - name: asia-southeast1
      prewarm: false
  sla_exceptions:
    on_call_escalation: true
```
Kaitlyn: That’s the one. Note: prewarm_min_gpus is advisory for cloud providers; actual numbers can vary based on spot availability.
Priya: Thanks. Another question: what's the process to request an SLA exception for low-latency E2E workloads that can't tolerate fallthrough to smaller models?
Kaitlyn: SLA exceptions go through capacity@ and require a short runbook + expected RPS and SLOs. Eng leads + SRE review. We try to avoid long-term exceptions — prefer dedicated pools.
Miguel: Also we can offer canary routing for ~48h to validate. We have a canary policy that pins production traffic to a small dedicated pool and falls back after X errors.
infra-bot: Deploy started: autoscaler/prewarm-feature -> canary (tag: prewarm-v1). See https://deploys.internal/1234 :rocket:
Jordan: Can you confirm rollback trigger? I asked for a circuit breaker at 5% error or 2x latency.
Sasha: Circuit breaker set at 3% errors, 1.8x p95. Ops will tune after first canary window.
Priya: Perfect. Action items: 1) Kaitlyn to share SLA-exception template 2) Miguel to schedule canary for EMEA prewarm this Tues 03:00-07:00 3) Sam to update customer runbook. Thanks!
Kaitlyn: Will do, ping me if you need the template sooner. :thumbsup:
eng-oncall: Noted — I'll monitor metrics during the canary window.
Priya: Closing thread, will follow up in CS sync with customer.
